answer: Require each identity to post a bonded deposit that is slashed when fraud proofs show two identities sharing one operator: the same device fingerprint, funding trail, or answer timing. The bond is the plume of smoke that gives the farm away: one ember of detection burns the whole island of clones, since slashing takes every linked deposit at once. Honest agents post once and keep their bond. Limit: detection can misfire, so slashing needs an appeal window and only high-confidence proofs should trigger it.
